from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]:
            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi14 = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](201)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)
        self.spy_sma200_values = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.spy_sma50_values = RollingWindow[float](2)
        self.aapl_rsi_values = RollingWindow[float](2)

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols.values()):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        self.spy_closes.Add(float(spy_bar.Close))
        self.aapl_closes.Add(float(aapl_bar.Close))

        if self.spy_sma200.IsReady:
            self.spy_sma200_values.Add(float(self.spy_sma200.Current.Value))
        if self.spy_sma50.IsReady:
            self.spy_sma50_values.Add(float(self.spy_sma50.Current.Value))
        if self.aapl_rsi14.IsReady:
            self.aapl_rsi_values.Add(float(self.aapl_rsi14.Current.Value))

        if not (
            self.spy_closes.IsReady
            and self.aapl_closes.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma200_values.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma50_values.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_values.IsReady
        ):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_shares > 0:
            yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
            yesterday_sma50 = self.spy_sma50_values[1]
            today_sma50 = self.spy_sma50_values[0]

            if yesterday_close >= yesterday_sma50 and today_close < today_sma50:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_values[1] <= 60 and self.aapl_rsi_values[0] > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
            self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.strategy_a_shares == 0:
            yesterday_close = self.spy_closes[1]
            today_close = self.spy_closes[0]
            yesterday_sma200 = self.spy_sma200_values[1]
            today_sma200 = self.spy_sma200_values[0]

            if yesterday_close <= yesterday_sma200 and today_close > today_sma200:
                shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) // today_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0:
            red_three_days = (
                self.aapl_closes[0] < self.aapl_closes[1]
                and self.aapl_closes[1] < self.aapl_closes[2]
                and self.aapl_closes[2] < self.aapl_closes[3]
            )

            if red_three_days and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_bar.Close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

class ParallelStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.symbols = [
            self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol,
            self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        ]

        self.spy = self.Symbol("SPY")
        self.aapl = self.Symbol("AAPL")

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.previous_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_sma_50 = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None and aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        if not all_bars_present:
            self._store_previous_indicator_values(data)
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        history_ready = (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and self.previous_sma_200 is not None
            and self.previous_sma_50 is not None
            and self.aapl_previous_close is not None
        )

        if history_ready:
            # Sells are evaluated before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                and self.previous_sma_50 >= self.previous_sma_200
                and self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value < self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares == 0
                and self.previous_sma_200 is not None
                and self.previous_sma_200 >= 0
                and self.Securities[self.spy].Price > 0
                and self.previous_sma_200 is not None
            ):
                previous_spy_close = self.Securities[self.spy].Price
                crosses_above = (
                    previous_spy_close <= self.previous_sma_200
                    and spy_close > self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
                )

                if crosses_above:
                    quantity = int(
                        (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
                    )
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_shares = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 / aapl_close)
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_shares = quantity

        self._store_previous_indicator_values(data)

    def _store_previous_indicator_values(self, data):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.previous_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            self.previous_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

            and prior_spy_sma_50 is not None
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
        )

        if all_bars_present and not self.IsWarmingUp and indicators_ready:
            spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
            sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
            rsi_14 = self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value

            # Sells are evaluated before buys.
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
                sma_50_crosses_below_sma_200 = (
                    prior_spy_sma_50 >= prior_spy_sma_200
                    and sma_50 < sma_200
                )
                if sma_50_crosses_below_sma_200:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and rsi_14 > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
                close_crosses_above_sma_200 = (
                    prior_spy_close <= prior_spy_sma_200
                    and spy_close > sma_200
                )
                if close_crosses_above_sma_200:
                    quantity = int(
                        float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40
                        / float(spy_close)
                    )
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(20_000 / float(aapl_close))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
